_about: Every public-domain John Bunyan (1628-1688) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is the collected Works: George Offor's edition (Glasgow: Blackie, 1854, 3 vols, the fullest collected edition), which Project Gutenberg carries as clean text (PG 6046-6048; PG 6049 is the same three volumes in one file and is not fetched). CCEL ThML is fetched for its structured titles. Single Gutenberg titles that are pieces of the Offor set are fetched too, so each is addressable as its own work. Modern editions (Oxford 'Miscellaneous Works' 1976-94, 1968 and 2006 reprints) are excluded.
